reminder.notes:
# Reminder 2.30.0 - Smoother in-app updates

### Features
- Update downloads can now be paused, resumed from where they stopped (even after closing the app), stopped, and retried after a network drop.
- Old update files are deleted automatically after an update installs.

### Bug fixes
- The same error with a different number is now grouped as one issue in error reports.

mirrordrive.notes:
### Security & Privacy
- Restricted to folders created by Mirror: only files and folders this app creates or you explicitly pick are accessed (drive.file scope) — never your whole Drive.

### UX & Transparency
- Scoped Drive picker to 'Mirror Folders' with clear privacy guidance and empty state explaining app-folder isolation.

twinclean.notes:
# TwinClean 1.4.0 - Unified non-blocking in-app updater

### Features

- Modernized update dialog with Router Warden design tokens, progress bar, and Later / Update Now actions.
- Settings screen now displays manual Check for Updates tile.

### Bug fixes

- Replaced blocking UpdateGateScreen splash interceptor with non-blocking background check.

taashclub.notes:
# Taash Club 1.20.0 - Unified non-blocking in-app updater

### Features

- New in-app updater: a non-blocking prompt with Later and Update Now, live download progress, and release notes shown before installing.
- Web version signs in through the shared PNSJY sign-in page.
- Web version adds a responsive desktop layout and installable (PWA) support.

### Bug fixes

- Replaced the old update prompt and external file opener with a direct package installer.

cards.notes:
# Cards 2.7.0 - Diagnostics log and smoother updates

### Features
- Update downloads can now be paused, resumed from where they stopped (even after closing the app), stopped, and retried after a network drop.
- Old update files are deleted automatically after an update installs.
- Settings > About > View diagnostics log shows a step-by-step record of app activity that you can copy into a bug report. It never includes card details, PINs or keys.

### Bug fixes
- Background update notifications now work (the version was read from the wrong field).

langkeeper.notes:
# LangKeeper 1.0.0 - First stable release

LangKeeper leaves beta. Sign-in now uses your PNSJY account, Google Drive backup asks for permission only when needed, and problems can be diagnosed from the app.

### Features
- Sign in with your PNSJY account in the browser (pnsjy-auth). The session is kept in secure storage and renews itself.
- Google Drive permission is requested only when you back up or restore.
- Diagnostics log on the Backup & Settings screen with one-tap copy.
- Optional "Send error reports" switch (off by default). It sends only cleaned-up error messages, never places, addresses, notes or account details.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed Google sign-in failing with "[16] Account reauth failed": the app's Android OAuth client is now registered.
- A refused Drive permission now shows the package and SHA-1 details instead of failing silently.

tributary.notes:
Tributary 0.1.0

### Features
- Link all your Gmail accounts once and stay signed in.
- Fold every account into one primary inbox, each under its own label, with no duplicates and all details kept.
- Per-account copy switches (off by default), old-mail copy with progress, and one-tap "fold everything".
- Stats per account: mail per day, unread, top senders, and a ready-to-retire hint.
- Read-only forwarding view with a shortcut to Gmail's forwarding settings.
- Full mail client: unified inbox, labels, search, read, reply, forward, archive, star, trash.
- 3D accounts hub, aurora background, 3D stats, dark and light themes.
- Diagnostics log and opt-in error reporting in Settings.

### Bug fixes
No user-facing bug fixes in this release.
